referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A clean medical template. A top navigation row sits above a split hero: a doctor portrait on the left and a white text card on the right with a short promise and two actions. A doctor introduction with a large experience badge follows, then a two-photo care band, a vertical timeline, a patient testimonial, a booking form, and a footer with hours and contact details. The typography is a neutral sans with large dark headings. White, pale blue, and navy accents create a calm clinical tone.
